major_cooldowns.name: Explosive Shot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, and fire both charges back to back thanks to Unstable Trigger, unless Lock and Load is already up.

major_cooldowns.name: Volley
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown for the free Trick Shots; on single target it rarely changes your priority since Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire already keep Precise Shots flowing.

major_cooldowns.name: Trueshot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown and time it to land right before a Rapid Fire so more of the channel benefits from its crit bonus. Swap onto an unmarked target first since pressing it applies your mark to whatever you have targeted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The guide states the effective cooldown is 90s with Calling the Shots or 2min with Unerring Vision; base_cd_s in the table is 120.

rule.description: Open with Aimed Shot, Explosive Shot, Volley, Trueshot
rule.action: Open with an early Aimed Shot, then Explosive Shot before Volley and Trueshot.

rule.description: Cast Trueshot right before Rapid Fire
rule.action: Time Trueshot so a Rapid Fire channel starts right after it, so more of the channel gets the crit buff.

rule.description: Spend Precise Shots before your next Aimed Shot
rule.action: Follow every Aimed Shot with a Precise Shots spender like Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot, or Kill Shot before your next Aimed Shot lands.

rule.description: Multi-Shot spends Precise Shots on multiple targets
rule.action: Switch your Precise Shots spender to Multi-Shot once you pick up a second target, since it hits everything for full damage.

rule.description: Arcane Shot stays a single-target spender
rule.action: Stop spending Precise Shots on Arcane Shot once you have multiple targets; use Multi-Shot there instead.
